title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 40
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 40: the man with the measuring reed, the gates and the courts, measured cubit by cubit.

questions.text: In which year of the captivity was Yahweh's hand on the prophet and he was brought there?
questions.explanation: It was in the twenty-fifth year of their captivity, in the beginning of the year, on the tenth day of the month.

questions.text: Where was he set down in the visions of God?
questions.explanation: In the visions of God he was brought into the land of Israel and set down on a very high mountain, on which was something like the frame of a city.

answers.text: In a valley full of bones
In the middle of the outer court

questions.text: What did the man whose appearance was like bronze have in his hand?
questions.explanation: There was a man whose appearance was like the appearance of bronze, with a line of flax in his hand and a measuring reed, and he stood in the gate.

answers.text: A line of flax and a measuring reed
A sword and a bronze shield
A scroll and a writing pen
A censer full of hot coals

questions.text: How long was the measuring reed in the man's hand?
questions.explanation: The measuring reed in the man's hand was six cubits long, of a cubit and a hand width each.

questions.text: What was the width of the opening of the gate that he measured?
questions.explanation: He measured the width of the opening of the gate, ten cubits, and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits.

questions.text: How many rooms were on the pavement of the outer court?
questions.explanation: In the outer court there were rooms and a pavement made all around, and thirty rooms were on the pavement.

questions.text: How many tables in all stood by the side of the gate, on which they killed the sacrifices?
questions.explanation: Four tables were on this side and four on that side, by the side of the gate: eight tables, on which they killed the sacrifices.

questions.text: Whose sons are the priests who keep the duty of the altar in the room facing north?
questions.explanation: The room facing toward the north is for the priests who keep the duty of the altar, and these are the sons of Zadok, who come near to Yahweh to minister to him.

questions.text: What were the measurements of the court that he measured, with the altar before the house?
questions.explanation: He measured the court, one hundred cubits long and a hundred cubits wide, square, and the altar was before the house.

questions.text: What were the length and the width of the porch of the house?
questions.explanation: The length of the porch was twenty cubits and the width eleven cubits, and there were pillars by the posts.
